roles.liquid: What a soup, stew or porridge is cooked in
roles.flour: What pastry, bread and batter are made from
roles.bread: A loaf or slices, as an ingredient
roles.garnish: Goes on a finished dish at the garnish spot

ingredients.name: Water
ingredients.description: From the pump out back. Free, wet, and never runs out.

ingredients.name: Stock
ingredients.description: Bones simmered until they gave up their secrets. The backbone of a good pot.

ingredients.name: Cooking ale
ingredients.description: Ale that never made it to a glass. It's happier in a stew anyway.

ingredients.name: Milk
ingredients.description: Fresh from Hollin's cows. Turns sour if you so much as look away.

ingredients.name: Lard
ingredients.description: Pig fat in a crock. Unglamorous, and it fries like a dream.

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.description: Churned, salted and golden. Makes almost anything taste like home.

ingredients.name: Flour
ingredients.description: Milled wheat by the pound. Dusts everything in the kitchen, including you.

ingredients.name: Oats
ingredients.description: Rolled oats for porridge. Sticks to your ribs, and to the pot.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.description: A pinch wakes a dish up. A fistful sends it back to bed.

ingredients.name: Egg
ingredients.description: Laid this morning by a hen with opinions.

ingredients.name: Loaf
ingredients.description: A crusty loaf. Sliced, toasted or torn, it never complains.

ingredients.name: Beef
ingredients.description: A good lump of beef. Wants a long, slow simmer to be at its best.

ingredients.name: Fowl
ingredients.description: A whole bird, plucked and ready. Light, homely, and only slightly offended.

ingredients.name: Smoked sausage
ingredients.description: Smoked links on a string. The smell alone fills seats.

ingredients.name: Fresh fish
ingredients.description: Caught this morning. By tomorrow, the whole kitchen will know.

ingredients.name: Mushroom
ingredients.description: Picked from the damp corners of the woods. Earthy, and only the friendly kind.

ingredients.name: Root veg
ingredients.description: Carrots, turnips and parsnips, still muddy. Sweet once they've had a cook.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.description: Makes the cook cry and the guests smile.

ingredients.name: Herbs
ingredients.description: A fragrant bunch from the garden. Strewn on top, it looks like you tried.

ingredients.name: Pepper
ingredients.description: Black pepper, cracked fresh. A little heat to keep guests awake.

ingredients.name: Apple
ingredients.description: Crisp and sweet, with the occasional worm for character.

ingredients.name: Berries
ingredients.description: A punnet of summer. Stains everything it touches, fingers first.

ingredients.name: Honey
ingredients.description: Golden and slow. The bees did the hard part.

ingredients.name: Walnut
ingredients.description: Crack the shell and mind your thumbs. Earthy and crunchy inside.

ingredients.name: Cheese & onion
ingredients.description: A wedge of sharp cheese and onion. Pungent, proud and very savoury.

ingredients.name: Breadcrumb
ingredients.description: Yesterday's bread, crumbled. Puts a crunch on anything that sits still.

ingredients.name: Lemon zest
ingredients.description: A lemon's bright skin, grated fine. Wakes up a sleepy dish.

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.description: Sweetness by the spoon. Keep it from the ants and the children.

ingredients.name: Nutmeg
ingredients.description: A little brown nut you grate. Smells like winter by the fire.

ingredients.name: Lemon wedge
ingredients.description: A wedge on the side. Sharp, bright, and quick to squeeze.

ingredients.name: Spice
ingredients.description: A warm, peppery mix from far away. A pinch goes a long way; two go further.

ingredients.name: Salted peanuts
ingredients.description: Salty, crunchy and impossible to stop at one. Guests get thirsty.

ingredients.name: Olives
ingredients.description: Briny little things in a bowl. Some guests adore them; others pretend to.

ingredients.name: Pickled eggs
ingredients.description: Eggs that sat in vinegar until they grew character. An acquired taste, then a habit.

ingredients.name: Pretzels
ingredients.description: Knotted, baked and salted. A bowl keeps the ale flowing.

ingredients.name: Dried apple rings
ingredients.description: Apples dried in rings by the stove. Sweet, chewy, and they keep for ages.

ingredients.name: Firewood
ingredients.description: Split logs for the hearth and the wood stoves. No logs, no fire, no stew.

ingredients.name: Lamp oil
ingredients.description: Oil for the lamps. Without it the inn goes dark and looks shut.

ingredients.name: Sundries
ingredients.description: Candles, soap, napkins and string. Nobody notices them until they're gone.

ingredients.name: Baker's pie
ingredients.description: A whole pie from Pell's ovens. Six honest slices, and nobody asks what's in it.

ingredients.name: Baker's bread
ingredients.description: A batch of Pell's loaves. Plain, soft and well behaved.

ingredients.name: Crostini
ingredients.description: Little toasts, crisp and savoury. Made to be nibbled with a drink.

ingredients.name: Roasted chestnuts
ingredients.description: Roasted till the shells split. Warm hands, sweet and earthy nuts.

ingredients.name: Peanuts
ingredients.description: Plain peanuts in a bowl. The salt's still in the sack.

ingredients.name: Chestnuts
ingredients.description: Raw chestnuts. Roast them first, unless you enjoy chewing furniture.

ingredients.name: Pickled onions
ingredients.description: Small onions in sharp vinegar. They bite back.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.description: A clove keeps a dish lively. A whole head keeps vampires, and friends, away.

ingredients.name: Salad greens
ingredients.description: A handful of tender leaves. Light, bright, and limp within a day or two.

ingredients.name: Radish
ingredients.description: Little red roots with a peppery kick. Crunchy and slightly rude.

ingredients.name: Pickled herring
ingredients.description: Herring in brine. Salty, silvery, and loved by sailors.

ingredients.name: Minced meat
ingredients.description: Finely chopped meat, ready for pies, patties, or getting lost in gravy.

ingredients.name: Pork
ingredients.description: A cut of pork. Rich, savoury, and happy over a slow fire.

ingredients.name: Lamb
ingredients.description: Tender lamb. Rich and fragrant, best with a sprig of something green.

ingredients.name: Bacon
ingredients.description: Smoked rashers. The smell reaches the street before you do.

ingredients.name: Tomato
ingredients.description: Red, tart and juicy. Squirts the cook at the worst moment.

ingredients.name: Chives
ingredients.description: Thin green stems snipped over the top. Bright, oniony and very tidy.

ingredients.name: Chamomile
ingredients.description: Dried flowers for a calm cup. For guests who need to sit down.

ingredients.name: Smoked leaf
ingredients.description: Tea smoked over pine. A campfire in a cup.

ingredients.name: Light roast
ingredients.description: Lightly roasted beans. Bright, lively coffee for early risers.

ingredients.name: Chicory
ingredients.description: A roasted root for a coffee-ish brew. Earthy, cheap, and nobody's fooled.

ingredients.name: Spiced blend
ingredients.description: Coffee with spices ground in. Fiery and warming, a winter favourite.

ingredients.name: Mint
ingredients.description: Fresh mint leaves for tea. Cools the mouth and clears the head.

ingredients.name: Black leaf
ingredients.description: Strong black tea. Bitter enough to wake the dead, or at least the regulars.

ingredients.name: Dark roast
ingredients.description: Dark-roasted beans, bitter and bold. The kind of coffee that argues.

ingredients.name: Ale
ingredients.description: Cold, bitter and hearty, by the pint. What most people come in for.

ingredients.name: Cider
ingredients.description: Crisp, sweet apple cider. Goes down easy; by the third, everyone's singing.
